notes: First implementation step of the new Act that lands directly on NRW's own decision making; the final statement shapes how SI3's integration agenda is applied in practice. The consultation closed on 11 September 2026 (verified 6 October 2026 on the gov.wales consultation page, which says responses are under review). Watch for the summary of responses and the final statement being laid before the Senedd; no date has been announced, so the event horizon is cleared.
summary: On 19 June 2026 the Welsh Government opened consultation on the draft Environmental Principles and Integrating Environmental Protection Statement under the Environment (Principles, Governance and Biodiversity Targets) (Wales) Act 2026. The statement operationalises the four principles (prevention, precaution, rectification at source, polluter pays) that Welsh Ministers and NRW must apply in policy making. The consultation closed on 11 September 2026; as of 6 October 2026 the Welsh Government was reviewing responses and had not published the outcome or the final statement, which the Act requires to be laid before the Senedd with a summary of representations.
title: Consultation on the Environmental Principles Statement that NRW must apply under the 2026 Act closed on 11 September 2026
